title: Experimental and theoretical evaluation of the corrosion inhibition performance of two benzimidazole derivatives for low carbon steel in acidic solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24815-24830
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02749G, Paper

Klodian Xhanari, Muhamed Farruku, Avni Berisha, Kledi Xhaxhiu, Jonida Canaj, Bujar Seiti, Efrosini Kokalari, Alketa Lame
Two benzimidazole derivatives, i.e. 2-(2-aminophenyl)-1H-benzimidazole (APhBI) and 2-(2-hydroxophenyl)-1H-benzimidazole (HPhBI) were found to successfully mitigate the corrosion of S235 steel in 1 M HCl solution, at 298–318 K.
